description: LaKNaTaO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.28 Å) and four longer (2.35 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All La-O bond lengths are 2.54 Å. Ta is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.86 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Ta atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₄NaTa octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Ta atom.
